description:
MSBuild integration for Adaptify.PureView.Tool. Add this package + the
tool as a dotnet tool; Adaptify.PureView.MSBuild.targets fires before the F# compiler and
regenerates *.g.fs for every [<PureView>] binding.
releaseNotes:
- fix: the MSBuild/Tool codegen path now de-qualifies generated output (the hand-rolled example generators always did; the Tool didn't). It emitted fully-qualified names verbatim, so `yield Aardvark.Dom.RenderControl.Samples 1` bound to the eponymous `RenderControl` TYPE — which shadows the AutoOpen module and whose `Samples` has a different (`FramebufferLayout`) signature — producing "Type constraint mismatch / no unique overload for Yield". De-qualify is now a shared `EmitAst.dequalify` called by BOTH the Tool and the example generators, so every consumer (MSBuild-driven or hand-rolled) gets the resolvable short form (`RenderControl.Samples`).
- engine: the free-var engine ("v2") is now THE analyzer — it rewrites every view body uniformly via free-variable analysis, replacing v1's per-construct dispatch. v1 is legacy, reachable only via `PUREVIEW_ENGINE=v1`.
- feat: a model collection rendered MORE THAN ONCE yields ONE per-element connector that offers all the views — e.g. the same list rendered as a UI `ul`/`li` AND as a scene-graph (`sg`) generates one `…Elem` module with a merged `Input`/`Connector` and one `compiled`/`compiled2`/… per view. Independent of whether the source is a record field and of how many times it is used (N=1 is the ordinary case).
- feat: live (fine-grained) adaptive combinators for collections — `zip` (positional, shorter-of-both-wins), `pairwise`, two-collection set algebra, and `AList.range`/`AList.init` rewrites — instead of coarse recompute-and-diff. Indexed transforms remain lifted via the safety net.
- fix: a value-typed adaptive consumer reading 2+ model fields in a single argument (`Sg.Translate(V3d(o.X, f o.ColorIx, 0.0))`) now lifts the ARGUMENT (`Sg.Translate(AVal.mapN … )`) rather than the whole call (which produced an `aval<SceneAttribute>` the `sg` builder can't `Yield`). Works for any arity.
title: Adaptify.PureView.MSBuild
